media_policy: Choose one current native dual-view or a single continuous synchronized composition per representative; do not duplicate side/wrist/dual/main of every run.
No splice across episodes, no trimming the main video before reset or before the actual terminal event, no hiding failed attempts. A failed full recording is not called a successful full task.

Prefer direct original bytes if within budget. If later recompression is necessary, label it a derived lossy presentation video, retain source hash, duration, frame count and timestamps, and verify decoded frame count/PTS/duration and key events. Do not alter exact model JPEGs to save package size.

Media soft caps may borrow from reserve only if final all-file total remains<=80,000,000bytes. If still too large, remove duplicate/optional clips or provide separate pinned original provenance; do not truncate an episode or drop actual results.

Pack every local figure/video/CSV/config link used by final MD/DOCX. Links in copied provenance JSON to original H5/raw/unselected observations are labelled source-only, not promised bundled files or fake GitHub URLs.
Final selected videos require full decode, visual review, time/episode binding, fileSHA and existence checks. ffprobe metadata here is not that QA.
